# Qidian Watch Bands

> Watch band manufacturer in Shenzhen, China. Custom silicone, TPU, nylon, ceramic, stainless steel and zinc alloy watch bands for brands, importers and independent sellers. No online checkout: enquiries run through WhatsApp or email.

## Key pages
- [Products](https://www.qidianwatchbands.com/products/): watch bands grouped by material
- [All watch bands](https://www.qidianwatchbands.com/products/all/): full product index
- [Custom and OEM](https://www.qidianwatchbands.com/custom-watch-straps/): OEM, ODM and private label process
- [Watch band size guide](https://www.qidianwatchbands.com/watch-band-size-guide/): lug width, strap length and wrist sizing
- [About](https://www.qidianwatchbands.com/about/): manufacturing scope and how we work
- [Contact](https://www.qidianwatchbands.com/contact/): inquiry checklist, WhatsApp and email

## Products
- [Band for Royal Pop](https://www.qidianwatchbands.com/products/silicone-watch-bands/band-for-royal-pop/): 20 mm strap · 44 mm case cradle · 142–216 mm wrists

## Facts
- Minimum order: samples from 1 piece; bulk from 10 pieces per colour; new tooling quoted per project
- Sampling: 7-10 working days; bulk production: 15-25 working days
- Lug widths: 16-24 mm, plus moulded connectors for smartwatch and tracker models
- Working in watch accessories since 2013
